limitations: Private 71-100.zip source all1390 original SRT cues /107778 bytes /45:25.559 with exact SHA 38d9... from preflight.
Video appears to self-date 2026-05-21 for KOSPI chart; public market day exact opening/closing points and video frames not independently synchronized.

Source audio/video chart/full independently retrieved public ASR not compared, ZIP and raw captions private.
